name: Christiansborg Palace
elevationDatum: Rigid exterior foundation plane y=0. Metres east/up/south; mapped orientation is baked once. No terrain, sea-level offset or Mercator scale is authored.
note: The106 m overall height is authoritative; intermediate values are mapped roof/profile estimates, not a commissioned survey. Palace roof folds, window modules, gateway arch, belfry openings, copper weathering, crown arch sections and finial details are photo-calibrated estimates. Historic roof tiles and pre-restoration green copper versions are not mixed into the modern brown-copper tower. Sculpture and heraldic relief are omitted rather than copied from reference photos. Cityscape and Full3D world verification remain a later batch stage. Cityscape: not tested. Full 3D world: not tested.
